issue.body:
## Problem

`formatLabel(name)` in `plugins/sample-kit/scripts/labels.mjs` starts with `if (name == null) return "";`. That branch is dead: its three callers, `render.mjs`, `export.mjs` and `cli.mjs`, each pass `String(item.name)`, and `item.name` is a required field the schema validates before any of them runs. So `name` is always a string.

## Fix

Remove the null check from `formatLabel`.

## Done when

- [ ] The null check is gone.
- [ ] No caller changes.
- [ ] The existing `formatLabel` tests still pass unchanged.

pr.title: refactor(sample-kit): drop the dead null check in formatLabel
pr.body: Removes the null check the issue shows is unreachable. Callers and tests are untouched.
